name: DatePickerCalendar
purpose: Choose a single date from a month grid.
intent: The month-grid panel that fills the date / date-time picker popup surface.

parts.day: figma-parts / day (component set 2417:61410): state (default | hover | press | previous selection) x isSelected x isFocused x isDisabled x today. Cell radius border/radius/sm; focus via the focus-ring primitive (border/focus).
parts.month-header: figma-parts / month-header (2417:60025): four icon-buttons (subtle, xs, square) around a month/year title (heading-xs, content/default).
parts.week-header: figma-parts / week-header (2417:61347): seven day-of-week labels (heading-xxs, content/default).
parts.week-days: figma-parts / week-days (2417:61453): one row of seven day cells; the grid stacks six of them.

figmaSource.notes: date-picker-calendar (2417:61761) is a single COMPONENT (no variants) composed of the parts above. The 'previous selection' day state is a range-preview state not implemented in this single-date v1. Out-of-month days are shown muted (content/disabled) but remain selectable (selecting switches month).

useCases: the popup body of a date field
antiPatterns: a full date field + popup (use Date Picker)
picking a time (use Time Picker / Date-Time Picker)
a small set of preset dates (use Select or Radio)

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: the transparent panel (padding spacing/lg); the popup provides the surface

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: prev-year / prev-month / title / next-month / next-year; nav are Icon Buttons (subtle, xs, square)

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: month + year (heading-xs), aria-live, labels the grid

anatomy.name: day
anatomy.description: a day cell in a gridcell; roving tabindex; states via data-today/selected/outside/disabled

accessibility.columnHeaders: one per weekday (aria-label = full weekday name)
accessibility.disabled: aria-disabled on the day button (kept focusable)
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys (day/week), Home/End (week), PageUp/PageDown (month; Shift = year), Enter/Space (select)

keyboardInteraction: ArrowLeft/Right move by one day; ArrowUp/Down by one week.
Home/End jump to the first/last day of the week.
PageUp/PageDown change month; Shift+PageUp/PageDown change year.
Enter/Space select the focused day (native button).
behaviorRules: Render six week rows for the displayed month; show adjacent-month days muted.
Uncontrolled selection via defaultValue; controlled via value + onChange.
Uncontrolled month via defaultMonth; controlled via month + onMonthChange.
Clamp min/max (inclusive); disable out-of-range days and block year/month nav once the whole target month is out of range.
isDateDisabled disables individual dates; disabled days are not selectable.
Mark today with aria-current and an underline; selected day fills the selected surface.
Use a roving tabindex and the WAI-ARIA grid keyboard model; focus uses the shared Focus Ring.
compositionRules: Render inside a popup surface (this panel is transparent).
Compose the Icon Button atom for the month/year nav.
The day, month-header, and week-header parts stay private anatomy.
contentRules: Month, year, and weekday names come from locale.
Nav button labels are configurable and should stay short.
responsiveRules: Fixed cell size (size-500 x size-400); the panel is sized by the seven columns plus padding.
themeRules: Do not reference primitive colors directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: React and TypeScript; React.forwardRef on the root.
CSS Modules and the shared Focus Ring; compose the Icon Button atom.
No MUI, no Tailwind, no hardcoded colors/typography/spacing.
Single-date selection; range ('previous selection') is a future addition.
do: Use inside a date field popup or an inline date surface.
Provide min/max or isDateDisabled to constrain selectable dates.
Set weekStartsOn and locale for the audience.
dont: Use as a standalone field (use Date Picker).
Give the panel its own heavy background (the popup provides the surface).
acceptanceCriteria: Renders the month title, weekday headers, and a six-week grid.
Marks today with aria-current="date" and the selected day's cell with aria-selected.
Selects a day on click (uncontrolled) and supports controlled value + onChange.
Navigates months and years from the header.
Disables out-of-range days and blocks nav past min/max; isDateDisabled disables individual dates.
Uses a roving tabindex and moves the focused day with the arrow keys, crossing month boundaries.
Does not use MUI or Tailwind.
